name: Kite-native liquid NSE EQ tactical universe

formation_method: Top-N current NSE EQ instruments by median daily traded value during the frozen formation window; daily traded value = sum(5-minute close * volume).

notes: Membership must be generated before Strategy 001J outcome evaluation. Do not modify the selected symbols using backtest or holdout results.
